_comment: Hand-maintained. scripts/speakers.py resolves speakers from titles, feed descriptions and transcript self-introductions; this file only records the judgement calls rules cannot make. aliases: any mention of the key becomes the value. episodes: force the speaker list for one lecture. distinct: bare surnames that must never be attached to a full name.

_notes.Lee: Every 'Dr. Lee' lecture in the feed is the morning-report series; feed descriptions call the presenter 'L Dogg' / 'Dr. L'Dogg' in 'Two Cases with Dr. Lawrence Lee'. Lee is a common surname, so the rules will not merge it on their own.
_notes.O'Keefe: 'Dr. Okeefe on Coma...' and 'Dr. Yasmin Keefe on Coma...' are the same recording (same length, same transcript), in which the speaker is introduced as 'Doctor O'Keefe'.
_notes.Miller: Left apart on purpose: 'Dr. Miller on Pediatric Urology' is a urologist (fellowship in San Diego per the transcript); Dr. Gerald C. Miller, PhD lectures on syphilis and COVID testing (RML).
_notes.Jones: Left apart: no evidence that the 'Drs Jones & Shannon' addiction lectures are Dr. Kyle Jones, DO (tuberculosis).
